description: The preferred citations packages publish in a documented equivalent of a CITATION.cff, which the methods inventory proposes in Methods (Implementation Decision 17; ticket 108): by language and by the package's distribution name, the work its maintainers ask users to cite, its DOI when it has one, and where the package publishes it. A citation is proposed only for a package whose method a current Methods passage relies on (it names the method by an alias of methods/aliases.json) and that the project's locks pin; a CITATION.cff in the package as the project's environment installed it is read first. Grow it by a harness ticket when a package publishes a preferred citation that is missing here.

numpy.citation: Harris, C. R. et al. (2020). Array programming with NumPy. Nature 585, 357-362.

scipy.citation: Virtanen, P. et al. (2020). SciPy 1.0: Fundamental Algorithms for Scientific Computing in Python. Nature Methods 17, 261-272.

scikit-learn.citation: Pedregosa, F. et al. (2011). Scikit-learn: Machine Learning in Python. Journal of Machine Learning Research 12, 2825-2830.
